products.title: Caribbean Curry
products.body_html:
• About
  • Ingredients

  • Sometimes a curry needs an island vibe. Our Caribbean Curry has our signature organic quinoa, loaded with hearty heartwarming root vegetables such as yams, potatoes, broccoli and carrots. The Caribbean Curry also brings the island heat with fresh ginger and cayenne pepper. This medley of sweet with heat will leave your taste buds asking for more!

    Why you'll want this in your pack:

    • Organic quinoa and coconut-curry spice with island-inspired flavor
    • A lighter, brighter alternative to heavy trail dinners
    • Ready to eat in minutes, straight from the pouch
    • Plant-based and gluten-free, made in small batches in Canada

  • INGREDIENTS: QUINOA, YAM, CARROT, SPLIT PEAS, ONION, BELL PEPPER, BROCCOLI, GINGER, POTATO FLAKE (POTATOES, MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES, SODIUM ACID, CITRIC ACID), SUNDRIED TOMATO, TOMATO PASTE (TOMATOES, SPICES, NATURAL FLAVORS, CITRIC ACID), OLIVE OIL, SALT, NATURAL FLAVOR, CURRY POWDER (SPICES, MUSTARD, SALT, GARLIC), BLACK PEPPER, THYME, CAYENNE PEPPER.

    Contains: Mustard.

    Please read our cross contamination policy on our FAQ page.

products.title: Breakfast Pack
products.body_html:
• About
  • Nutrition

  • Start Your Adventure with a Power-Packed Breakfast

    Fuel your day with the ultimate breakfast trio from Nomad Nutrition—the perfect way to kickstart your adventures. Our thoughtfully crafted Breakfast Pack includes three delicious, nutrient-dense meals designed to energize and satisfy your hunger on the trail or wherever your journey takes you along with a delicious energy packed mushroom hot chocolate.

    What's Inside?

    Hempola: Original Cereal

    • A wholesome blend of hemp hearts, nuts, and seeds, this crunchy and hearty cereal is packed with plant-based protein, omega-3s, and fiber to keep you fueled for hours.

    • Enjoy it with hot or cold water, or pair it with your favorite milk for a nutritious and satisfying start to your day.

    Southwest Breakfast Skillet

    • Bold and savory, this meal features seasoned potatoes, bell peppers, and black beans for a flavorful, protein-packed breakfast.

    • With a hint of spice, it’s a warm and energizing way to wake up your taste buds.

    Cali Breakfast Bowl

    • Bright, fresh, and packed with goodness, the Cali Breakfast Bowl includes quinoa, kale, and sweet potatoes, topped off with aromatic herbs and spices.

    • Perfect for those looking for a nutrient-dense, plant-based breakfast option.

    Why Choose Nomad Nutrition?

    • Plant-Based & Gluten-Free: Our meals are crafted for adventurers seeking clean, wholesome food.

    • Lightweight & Easy to Prepare: Just add water, and you’ll have a hot, satisfying meal ready in minutes.

    • Nutritious & Delicious: Carefully formulated to deliver the nutrients you need to power through your day.

    Whether you’re climbing mountains, exploring new trails, or just tackling a busy morning, the Nomad Nutrition Breakfast Pack has you covered. Eat well, adventure more, and conquer your day.


    Shelf-life 36 months from date of manufacture.

    Qualifies for FREE SHIPPING

  • Our high-quality ready-to-eat meals are:

    Rich in Plant-Based Proteins
    Excellent source of fibre
    Without added anything

products.title: 5 serving Bulk Bag - 560g
products.body_html:
• About
  • Ingredients

  • NEW! - Now available everywhere!

    Worried about not packing enough food for your trip? Or are the variety of meals taking unnecessary storage space?

    We've got you! The Nomad Nutrition Medium Bulk Meals are back for good! It is the perfect size for explorers, outdoor enthusiasts, and campers! This 560 gram pouch is filled with nutrition recipes made with high-quality plant-based whole foods, nut-free, gluten-free, and non-GMO ingredients to fuel your activities all day long! The medium bag can last you for the weekend or to be enjoyed across a multi-day getaway.

    • 560 grams can serve about 5 meals
    • Perfect for multi-day trips.
    • The meal can be shared among friends and family.
    • Only cook what you need.
    • Fits into a regular-sized backpack.
    • Can be used as an emergency food supply.

    Please note that this meal pouch is intended for storage only and should not be used for cooking inside.

    Shelf Life: 36 months.
    The shelf life of this product is not guaranteed once it has been opened.

    CALI BREAKFAST BOWL: Yam, Potatoes, Quinoa, Onions, Green pepper, Tofu, Chickpeas, Kalamata Olives, Diced tomatoes, Kale, Garlic, Black pepper, Turmeric, Cayenne, Basil, Olive oil, Sea salt.

products.title: Protein Crumble - Light Beef flavour
products.body_html:
• About
  • Ingredients

  • NEW!

    Introducing Protein Crumble, the irresistible savory Light Beef-flavored plant protein snack that adds a burst of hearty, smoky goodness to your day. Perfect for munching on the go or enhancing your favorite dehydrated meals, Protein Crumble is the versatile and delicious way to stay fueled.

    Why Choose Protein Crumble?

    • Light Beef flavor: A savory, smoky, umami-rich bite that tastes like the real thing — 100% plant-based.
    • High Protein Content: Packed with high-quality plant protein, Protein Crumble supports muscle recovery and keeps you energized throughout the day.
    • Versatile & Convenient: Enjoy it straight from the bag as a tasty snack, or sprinkle it onto your Nomad meal for an added layer of flavor and nutrition.
    • Portable & Lightweight: Ideal for busy lifestyles, camping trips, or emergency food supplies. Protein Crumble is easy to carry, store, and enjoy anywhere.

    Usage Ideas:

    • Snack on Protein Crumble during your workday for a delightful and healthy treat.
    • Add to your salads, soups, or grain bowls for an extra protein boost and a burst of flavor.
    • Mix into your dehydrated meals while camping or hiking to enhance both taste and nutritional value.

    Elevate your snacking game with Protein Crumble - Light Beef flavor, and make every meal a deliciously satisfying adventure!

  • INGREDIENTS: Plant Protein (pea protein isolate, gluten-free oat flour, rice protein, plant nutrient extract blend [tomato, broccoli, carrot, shiitake mushrooms, cranberry, apple, orange]), Expeller pressed canola oil, Natural flavours (contains yeast extract, salt, coconut oil, celery juice powder, carrot juice powder, onion juice powder, herbs), Apple cider vinegar, Spices

    Please read our cross contamination policy on our FAQ page.
